name: Speedy Windshield Repair
address: 2710 Garnet Ave Ste 201, San Diego, CA 92109, USA

quotes.text: I had a great experience with Speedy Windshield Repair! They replaced the rear windshield of my car quickly and efficiently. The entire process was smooth, and the customer service was excellent from start to finish. The staff was friendly, professional, and made everything easy. I really appreciated how fast they got me back on the road. I highly recommend them if you’re looking for quality work and great service!
quotes.author: Winy Mello

quotes.text: Amazing customer service! Excellent work and yes they are speedy! Got my windshield replaced and was so pleasantly surprised when Michael presented me with a "thank you" gift bag. So rare to see engaged service - this place has it..highly recommend.
quotes.author: sylvia tamayo
